answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond from a scarce, externally costly resource, then slash it when the agent double-signs or breaks a verifiable protocol rule. A Sybil attacker can still mint many identities, but must lock up a separate bond for each one; identities are no longer free, and coordinated abuse risks losing the stake. The bond might be recorded in a vault, with ferrous tokens or marble counters serving only as colorful labels: the deterrent is the real, slashable value, not the name or identity count.
